source: Global Entity Directory.pdf (NotebookLLM summary). Verify against the original BRSR.

derived.energy_method: Disclosed total electricity in GJ converted to kWh (1 GJ = 277.78 kWh). Monthly split is an even 1/12 of the annual total.
derived.waste_method: Disclosed non-hazardous and e-waste tonnes converted to kg per month (annual / 12).

notes: Scope 1 is not calculated: the fuel split is not disclosed, so no litre-based calculation is possible.
Scope 2 is compared on a location basis: the calculator applies one grid factor to all electricity.
